displayItems.description:
Welcome to the Contoso Global Solutions Multi-Region Deployment Training. Follow the steps below to get started.

1. Login to Azure Portal using the credentials provided above.
2. You will see 2 resource groups assigned to you — RG-02 (Sandbox) and RG-03 (Pre-deployed Storage).
3. Connect to the Jump VM using the Connect button on this page.
4. Complete all 4 exercises listed below.

Goal: Understand the pre-created resource groups in your lab environment.

Steps:
1. Login to Azure Portal at https://portal.azure.com
2. Click on Resource Groups in the left menu
3. You will see 2 resource groups assigned to you:
   - ODL-contoso-lab-XXXXXX-02 (Sandbox)
   - ODL-contoso-lab-XXXXXX-03 (Pre-deployed Storage)
4. Click on RG-03 and explore the pre-deployed storage account
5. Note down the storage account name shown in the Environment tab

Expected Result: You should see both resource groups and be able to navigate into each one.

displayItems.displayName: Exercise 2: Explore the Pre-Deployed Storage Account
displayItems.description:
Goal: Explore the storage account that was automatically deployed in RG-03.

Steps:
1. Go to Azure Portal → Resource Groups → RG-03
2. Click on the Storage Account resource
3. Explore the following sections:
   - Overview: Note the location, replication type and performance tier
   - Containers: Check if any blob containers exist
   - Access Keys: View the storage account keys
   - Configuration: Check TLS version and HTTPS settings
4. Copy the Primary Blob Endpoint URL shown in the Environment tab
5. Paste it in your browser to verify it is accessible

Expected Result: You should be able to view all storage account properties and settings.

displayItems.displayName: Exercise 3: Create Resources in Your Sandbox (RG-02)
displayItems.description:
Goal: Create your own Azure Storage Account in the sandbox resource group RG-02.

Steps:
1. Go to Azure Portal → Resource Groups → RG-02
2. Click + Create → search for Storage Account → click Create
3. Fill in the following details:
   - Resource Group: Select RG-02
   - Storage Account Name: Enter a unique name (3-24 lowercase letters/numbers)
   - Region: East US
   - Performance: Standard
   - Redundancy: LRS
4. Click Review + Create → Create
5. Wait for deployment to complete
6. Navigate to the new storage account and explore its properties

Expected Result: A new storage account should be successfully created in RG-02.

Goal: Understand how resources can be deployed across multiple Azure regions.

Steps:
1. Go to Azure Portal → Resource Groups
2. Compare the locations of resources in RG-02 and RG-03
3. In RG-02, create a second storage account in a DIFFERENT region:
   - Click + Create → Storage Account
   - Region: Select West US (different from East US)
   - Complete the creation steps
4. Once created, compare both storage accounts:
   - Note the different regions
   - Note the different endpoints
   - Note how data replication works differently per region
5. Go to Azure Portal → search Paired Regions to understand region pairing concepts

Expected Result: You should understand how Azure supports multi-region deployments and why region selection matters for availability and compliance.
